dataSource.provenanceMeaning: Hand-made example data. Not a real recording.

app_active_duration.label: App Active Duration
app_active_duration.definition: Seconds during which the application was the frontmost one while the user was active (no idle, lock, sleep or pause). A stretch still open at the end counts until the recording ended.

app_activation_count.label: App Activation Count
app_activation_count.definition: How many times the application newly became the frontmost one (start of the recording or a switch to it). Coming back after idle, lock or pause does NOT add an activation.

app_session_count.label: App Session Count
app_session_count.definition: Number of continuous active stretches of the application. Differs from the activation count whenever an idle, lock or pause interrupted a stretch.

website_active_duration.label: Website Active Duration
website_active_duration.definition: Seconds during which the site (normalized domain) was the active page of the frontmost browser. A PART of that browser's application time — never add the two.

website_activation_count.label: Website Activation Count
website_activation_count.definition: How many times the site newly became the active one (start, switch of tab or site, browser brought to the front).

app_transition_count.label: App Transition Count
app_transition_count.definition: Number of switches from one application to a different one, as a directed matrix (row = from, column = to).

website_transition_count.label: Website Transition Count
website_transition_count.definition: Number of switches from one site to a different one (also across browsers), as a directed matrix.

mouse_click_count.label: Mouse Click Count
mouse_click_count.definition: Number of button presses. macOS clicks (display coordinates) and clicks inside web pages (viewport coordinates) are counted separately and NOT added: a click on a page can appear in both.

spatial_click_coordinates.label: Spatial Click Coordinates
spatial_click_coordinates.definition: Click positions as x/y between 0 and 1 (origin top-left, y down) on their own display or page viewport, with the original coordinates and the display/viewport size.

measurementUnits.duration: seconds (decimal, millisecond resolution). Requested, elapsed and observed-active durations are different measures.
measurementUnits.count: whole numbers: activations, sessions, transitions and clicks are different counts
measurementUnits.timestamp: UTC epoch milliseconds (…Ms) with the local ISO-8601 time at that moment (…Local)
measurementUnits.normalizedPosition: 0..1, origin top-left, y grows downward, relative to the display or page viewport the click happened on
measurementUnits.displayCoordinates: macOS points (Quartz), origin top-left of the display; width/height in points
measurementUnits.pageCoordinates: CSS pixels inside the page viewport, origin top-left (not screen coordinates); scroll offsets are separate

neverCollected: full URLs, paths, queries, page titles
